newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shares in Atag fall sharply on forecast.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Atag fall sharply on forecast.

text.p: Shares in industrial group Atag Holding fell 14 percent or 14.60 guilders to 89.90 guilders on Friday after the firm's unfavourable forecast for full-year 1996 profits undermined the stock.
Dealers said the much lower third quarter result had been expected as the firm had earlier given a profit warning, but the full-year forecast gave the market a shock.
Earlier, Atag said that third quarter results fell to 1.3 million guilders from 4.5 million in the same period of 1995.
Net profits for the whole of 1996 were expected to be 30-40 percent lower, the firm said.
"The share could slip a touch further if private investors step out of the stock when the disappointing forecast makes the newspapers," said one dealer.
But, he added that the stock had fallen enough and that further falls in the share price would just be temporary.
"At the current price Atag is worth a hold," he said.
